name: My agents: owner, filter and duplicate-name warning
summary: Each My agents row shows its owner account plus the agent id from the loaded agent_view (owner, owner_display_name, id); a Mine/All filter (default Mine, client-side on the loaded list) renders only for a superuser or when more than one owner is present; creating an agent whose name matches a loaded row warns with the existing name, owner and id plus a confirm (cross-owner reuse stays allowed; the server 409 on secret-file clash stays the backstop); an agent that has acted (last_seen_at set) carries a disable-not-delete hint naming attribution. No visibility change: the server scopes the list as before.
